newsitem.title: INDIA: Bomb explodes in bus in India's northeastern state.
newsitem.headline: Bomb explodes in bus in India's northeastern state.

text.p: GUWAHATI, India, Nov 21 - A bomb exploded in a bus on Thursday in India's northeastern state of Assam, but there were no immediate reports of deaths or injuries, local police said.
Police said the bomb exploded in a private bus which was not carrying passengers in Guwahati, the state capital.
"Only the driver and his assistant were there in the bus. We have arrested them and interrogations are on," a police official, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters.
